Review of Proposal Requirements (1-3 minutes) - Confirming deliverables including budget, text, RFI component

  • Briefly restate specific requirements and objectives

  • Clarify any questions or concerns about specific deliverables that arose the OLC

 

Win Themes and Key Messaging (3-6 minutes) - Confirming key win themes as outlined in the OLC

  • Outline key study challenges/ barriers to delivery

  • Collaborate with the BD (strategic alignment/partnership history) and TSL (medical considerations/operational delivery) to identify the key win themes for the proposal that will address challenges

 

Unique Approaches to Achieve Win Themes & Contributors (6-14 minutes) - Building the strategy more completely and who is responsible for delivering the message on that strategy             

  • Determine prioritization and key messaging that will support each win theme

  • Identification of IQVIA-specific innovative and unique strategies to achieve each win theme

  • Identify responsible parties and contributors for creating text content for each win theme

 

Timeline for Text Deliverables (3-5 minutes)  

  • Present the proposed timeline for the development of the text deliverables

  • Identify key milestones, including:

  • Timing for full proposal draft to be sent to wider review team

  • Contacting individuals responsible for specific sections

  • Deadline for text lock

  • Review and feedback process

  • Final draft submission

  • Update Unity accordingly

 

Next Steps and Action Items (2 minutes)

  • Summarize the key decisions made during the meeting

  • Assign action items and responsibilities to each team member

  • Discuss the next steps and set a timeline for follow-up text meetings and/or communication

The MAP call will follow the agenda below. The majority of this call is designated for country/site validation and finalization. Please come prepared to support your data/output; all participants will represent the data they have gathered, as well as their analysis and interpretation, while also validating the proposed strategy.   ​

1.       Introduction, rollcall, background (TAL/TSL/Medic): Brief recap including Sponsor, phase, country considerations (must have or no-go countries) and sponsor considerations with a focus on any new information received since strategy and/or data planning calls. ​

2.       Analytics Lead Engagement (Feasibilityand Site Analytics): Brief summary/presentation of the data and analysis for which team member is responsible throughout call: please, ensure to balance the content and allotted time.

3.       Enrollment simulation (TAL):Provided sufficient information is available before the call, the ASL will have a pre-populated model with known information from RFP specs and will facilitate this part of MAP call.  The TSL will guide the team to develop and finalize a viable, data-driven study strategy.

Review of Proposal Requirements (1-3 minutes) - Confirming deliverables including budget, text, RFI component

  • Briefly restate specific requirements and objectives

  • Clarify any questions or concerns about specific deliverables that arose the OLC

 

Win Themes and Key Messaging (3-6 minutes) - Confirming key win themes as outlined in the OLC

  • Outline key study challenges/ barriers to delivery

  • Collaborate with the BD (strategic alignment/partnership history) and TSL (medical considerations/operational delivery) to identify the key win themes for the proposal that will address challenges

 

Unique Approaches to Achieve Win Themes & Contributors (6-14 minutes) - Building the strategy more completely and who is responsible for delivering the message on that strategy             

  • Determine prioritization and key messaging that will support each win theme

  • Identification of IQVIA-specific innovative and unique strategies to achieve each win theme

  • Identify responsible parties and contributors for creating text content for each win theme

 

Timeline for Text Deliverables (3-5 minutes)  

  • Present the proposed timeline for the development of the text deliverables

  • Identify key milestones, including:

  • Timing for full proposal draft to be sent to wider review team

  • Contacting individuals responsible for specific sections

  • Deadline for text lock

  • Review and feedback process

  • Final draft submission

  • Update Unity accordingly

 

Next Steps and Action Items (2 minutes)

  • Summarize the key decisions made during the meeting

  • Assign action items and responsibilities to each team member

  • Discuss the next steps and set a timeline for follow-up text meetings and/or communication

The MAP call will follow the agenda below. The majority of this call is designated for country/site validation and finalization. Please come prepared to support your data/output; all participants will represent the data they have gathered, as well as their analysis and interpretation, while also validating the proposed strategy.   ​

1.       Introduction, rollcall, background (TAL/TSL/Medic): Brief recap including Sponsor, phase, country considerations (must have or no-go countries) and sponsor considerations with a focus on any new information received since strategy and/or data planning calls. ​
